target_questions.question: Do pressure ratio and gas species independently support Mach-disk growth and downstream mixing localization?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 B009 provides the primary matched-species/NPR anchor; this newer CFD study supplies an independent method and range.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: The simulations report larger Mach-disk dimensions and jet volume with increasing pressure ratio, with principal mixing downstream of the Mach disk and along turbulent jet boundaries.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: Hydrogen cases are validated against measurements and decomposed to identify coherent mixing structures, with methane used as a comparison.

limitations: CFD method and transitional regime; quantitative comparison requires compatible pressure definitions and geometry.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
